notes.title: New Update for The Last Farmer: Bug Fixes, Improvements, and a Handy NPC!
notes.content:
Dear Farmers,

A new update for The Last Farmer is here, bringing key fixes and a helpful new feature to make your survival journey smoother than ever!

Meet the New NPC
 A new NPC has arrived at the survivors’ base! For a fee, they can bring your vehicle back to base - perfect for when you find yourself stuck in the wild.

Bug Fixes and Improvements
 Here’s what we’ve addressed in this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed buildable items that could reset save progress.
[*] Resolved an issue with a door at the Substation that couldn’t be opened after clearing zombies.
[*] Fixed biofuel consumption to prevent deleting your entire biofuel inventory when used.
[*] Corrected zombie behavior at the Substation; they’ll no longer scatter excessively during clear-out missions.
[*] Fixed the inability to pick up the fuse in certain scenarios.
[*] Resolved overlapping player tasks after loading a save.
[*] Fixed the save menu opening upon death.
[*] Added missing localization for certain text elements.
[*] Reduced fuel consumption for the generator at the Substation.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing trading after completing certain tasks.
[*] Added plant growth during sleep.
[*] Added automatic watering of beds when it rains.
[/list]

This update focuses on addressing player-reported issues while adding a small but useful feature to improve your experience.

Thank you for your continued feedback - it helps us make The Last Farmer even better! Jump in and check out the changes, and don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us.

Happy farming,
 The Last Farmer Team

notes.title: New Update for The Last Farmer: Controls, Missions, and Location Expansion!
notes.content:
A new update for The Last Farmer is here, bringing exciting features and important fixes to enhance your survival experience!

- Customizable Controls: Adjust gameplay to suit your style with the newly added control settings.
- New Mission: Take on a thrilling new challenge and uncover more of the game’s world.
- Expanded Location: Explore the “Substation” area with fresh opportunities and hidden surprises.

Additionally, we’ve polished gameplay with the following improvements:
- Enhanced sound effects for breaking wooden crates.
- Fixed animations and adjusted tool positioning for a more realistic feel, along with refined object impact effects.
- Resolved an issue near the player’s spawn area that previously restricted item placement.
- Fixed ladder alignment issues during construction.

Thank you for your feedback and support! Your input inspires every change and addition we make, so keep those ideas coming! Dive into the update and let us know what you think.

Happy farming,
The Last Farmer Team

notes.title: New Update Available Now: Customize Your Apocalypse Machine in The Last Farmer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972774/a9852c0fe2c0d18b68d24daf007c70ca994d339d.gif[/img]

Dear Farmers,

We’re thrilled to announce that a new update is now live in The Last Farmer! Many of you have been eagerly awaiting this release, and now you can customize your vehicle and transform it into a true apocalypse machine!

With this new feature, you can personalize your vehicle’s look and add some rugged functionality to help you survive the undead-infested lands. These customizations won’t impact the vehicle’s basic handling, but they will give you an edge against zombies—allowing you to take less damage and deal more as you navigate the wastelands.

Upgrade your ride today and make it a true powerhouse against the zombie horde!

In addition to vehicle upgrades, we’ve made a few other improvements:

[list]
[*] Added an option to invert mouse controls.
[*] Fixed animal navigation within farm fences.
[*] Resolved an issue where the feeder could not be picked up.
[*] Fixed the building foundation to allow placement of certain items, like the workbench and bedroll.
[*] Tents are now destructible.
[/list]

Thank you for all your fantastic feedback that helped bring this feature to life. Keep farming, keep surviving, and we can’t wait to see your customized apocalypse machines in action!

Happy farming,
The Last Farmer Team

notes.title: The Last Farmer – Update #2: Enhanced Challenges and New Survival Tools
notes.content:
Dear Farmers,

We are excited to share with you the second major update for The Last Farmer! We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and continue to enhance the game based on your suggestions. This update brings a variety of new mechanics and improvements to make your adventure even more immersive and enjoyable.

[list]
[*] Here are the main changes and improvements included in this update:
[*] New Task: After crafting the portable workbench, players will now receive a task to repair the next workbench.
[*] Loot and Atmospheric Details: In some locations, you’ll now find bodies of fallen survivors, which can be looted, though they are always surrounded by zombies. It’s risky, but worth it. Additionally, military zombies now have a chance to drop ammo, helping you in combat.
[*] Map Navigation: We’ve added the ability to place a marker on the mini-map, making navigation easier and eliminating the need to constantly reopen it.
[*] Blocking Mechanic: We’ve introduced a blocking feature, activated by the right mouse button. This mechanic helps players defend against zombies, using stamina in the process. Remember, once stamina is depleted, blocking won’t prevent damage, so be strategic in managing your energy.
[*] Performance Optimization: We’ve made a number of changes to improve performance, which we hope will enhance the overall player experience and provide smoother gameplay.
[*] Additional Backpack Slots: If your inventory feels too limited, rejoice — backpacks now support more slots, letting you carry more resources and gear.
[/list]
We’re grateful for your participation and feedback, which help us improve The Last Farmer. Wishing you luck and happy farming in a world full of challenges!

Best,
The Last Farmer Team

notes.title: New Update: Improvements and Bug Fixes Based on Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Dear Farmers,

We are pleased to announce a new update for The Last Farmer, which brings a host of improvements and bug fixes designed to enhance your experience. Your feedback has been instrumental in identifying areas where we could improve, and we’re grateful for the support and suggestions from our community.

This update includes a range of improvements to gameplay, as well as fixes for specific issues that players have reported. We’ve listed the key improvements and bug fixes below:

[list]
[*] The car headlight radius has been increased to improve visibility and orientation at night.
[*] Vehicle mobility and speed have been enhanced to make it easier to navigate rough terrain.
[*] The Wandering Trader mechanic has been reworked, increasing the chances of encountering them near your base to make trading more accessible.
[*] Night lighting has been updated for a more comfortable experience, making it easier to navigate and explore at night.
[*] Additional light sources have been added to certain objects to improve visibility and environmental detail.
[*] The game’s save system has been refined to increase reliability and ease of use.
[/list]

We encourage you to continue providing your feedback as we work to create the best possible experience in The Last Farmer. Your input is instrumental in guiding our development efforts and ensuring the game meets your expectations.

Thank you for being a part of our community, and happy farming!

Best, 
The Last Farmer Team

notes.title: Your Feedback Matters: RoadMap of Upcoming Changes for The Last Farmer!
notes.content:
Dear Farmers,

We want to take a moment to express our gratitude for your feedback since the launch of The Last Farmer. Your insights and suggestions have been invaluable in helping us shape the game and enhance your experience.

In response to your input, we’ve put together a roadmap outlining the changes and improvements we plan to implement in the near future. We are committed to ensuring that The Last Farmer continues to evolve and meet your expectations.

While we are still finalizing specific details, we want to assure you that your voices have been heard, and we are dedicated to making the game even better.

Below are the key changes we plan to implement based on your valuable feedback:

[list]
[*] Autosave will be added, and save stability will be improved for smooth data loading.
[*] Game loading and performance will be optimized to reduce freezes and improve loading times.
[*] The issue with the cutscene will be resolved.
[*] Vehicles will get improved handling, speed, and off-road capability, a wider headlight radius, and upgrade options.
[*] Zombie attacks will be made more varied with new attack types.
[*] The weight of corpses will be adjusted for more realistic lifting animations.
[*] Tool, eating and drinking, melee combat, and fuel refill animations will be refined for greater realism.
[*] Graphics and lighting will be reworked to enhance visual experience.
[*] A quick transfer button for items will be added to the inventory.
[*] The weapon crafting mechanic will be updated for more flexibility and depth.
[*] More side missions and quests will be added for a more varied gameplay experience.
[*] And much more. For details, stay tuned to our upcoming patch notes, where we’ll share a full rundown of the changes.
[/list]
The first update with bug fixes and improvements will be released on October 26.

We’re excited to share this journey with you and are eager to roll out these updates based on your feedback. Please stay tuned for more information on the specific changes coming your way!

Thank you for being a part of our community. Your support and engagement mean the world to us!

Happy farming,
The Last Farmer Team

notes.title: New Update for The Last Farmer: Meet the Merchant with Essential Supplies!
notes.content:
Greetings, Farmers!

We’re excited to announce that a new update is now live, bringing some exciting changes to The Last Farmer. The main highlight of this update is the arrival of the Wandering Merchant, a mysterious figure who travels at night, offering to trade supplies for your crops. He also carries a unique item that you won’t find anywhere else, making him a valuable resource for players.

With the Wandering Merchant, you’ll find it much easier to swap your crops for essential supplies. 
Whether you’re running low on items or simply looking to exchange what you’ve harvested, he’s ready to deal. But be warned - rumor has it his exchange rates aren’t as favorable as those of other merchants.

While he offers convenience, you might want to think twice before agreeing to his terms!
We hope this new addition enriches your experience and adds more strategic depth as you manage your farm and resources. As always, we’re eager to hear your feedback, so let us know what you think of the Wandering Merchant and the latest update.

Happy trading, and good luck spotting the Merchant - he may have just what you need!

Until next time,
The Last Farmer Team

notes.title: Enhanced Visuals and Gameplay Comfort in The Last FARMER’s Full Version!
notes.content:
Welcome to The Last FARMER, where farming meets adventure in a post-apocalyptic world. We’re excited to share our latest update, which brings great new features to the full version of the game!

In this update, you’ll notice improved graphics that make your fields and crops look more vibrant and detailed. The world around you is now more immersive, making your farming experience even more enjoyable.

We’ve also worked hard to fix bugs that may have disrupted your gameplay. With these fixes, you can expect smoother performance, allowing you to dive into the game without interruptions.

Additionally, thanks to your feedback, we’ve made various improvements that make it easier to navigate and interact with the game. Our goal is to create a comfortable and user-friendly experience for all players.

Thank you for your ongoing support! We hope you’ll enjoy the new features in the full version when it launches. Happy farming!

notes.title: Exciting Changes Coming to The Last Farmer – Thanks to Our Community!
notes.content:
Thanks to the invaluable feedback from our The Last Farmer - Prologue community, we’ve made several improvements and additions that will be included in the main version of the game, set to release soon. 

Your suggestions and insights have helped us fine-tune the gameplay and deliver a more immersive, polished survival experience.

Here’s what we’ve added:
- Enhanced Combat Mechanics: The military’s pursuit radius has been adjusted, and we’ve introduced a new firing system to make combat more strategic.
- New Features: A radio has been added to the car, and gasoline canisters are now placed in more logical, accessible locations.
- More Wildlife: You’ll encounter an increased number of animals in the world, adding more life and hunting opportunities.
- Improved Stamina Management: Food and water now restore stamina, enhancing the survival aspects of the game.
- Zombie Recycling Machine: A new machine allows you to convert zombies into fertilizer, adding a unique touch to your farming efforts.
- Bug Fixes: We’ve addressed various bugs to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

We are deeply grateful to our amazing community for their feedback, which has shaped the direction of the game. We hope you enjoy these changes and have an even better experience when The Last Farmer is officially released. Thank you for your continued support!

We can’t wait to continue this journey with you!
